notes.title: It was fun using Unity
notes.content:
MidnightKing is made with Unity, I've learned and worked on this game for the past 2 years. It was fun but I had to stop since there was a lot of spaghetti code and no overall substance in the game. I do not expect this game to do good commercially, it represents my persistence to continue learning even if the first scripts I made were 2 years old.

I learned a lot, but since the controversy with Unity, I decided I needed to switch to Godot. Even if the decision is reverted, I've afraid for their future decisions. 

I'll release my game after SteamFest and continue making games on itch.io for a while.
Thanks for all the support.

notes.title: SteamFest Is Almost Here
notes.content:
Since my last announcement I've learned Godot and stopped using Unity (for reasons) and I've made another game during the GBJam11 on itch.io. I'm really enjoying the engine and I hope that I can make my next game great.

A lot happened for the last 2 years of my life and MidnightKing didn't turn out like I thought it would. But that's okay, I learned a lot and it was in no way a waste. This is my first commercial game so I don't expect it to do well. 

I'm not going to stop making games because of some obstacles or inconveniences, those are proof that I'm progressing and to keep pushing.

It's been a journey but I'll release it for all this see this piece of shit.

notes.title: An Announcement After A Week
notes.content:
So I completed the introduction to the game, I'm working on adding more enemies and finally adding the improved mechanics for the boss. I may be able to get the second area done (no promises). 

At the end of August I will push a live update of the game.

notes.title: Preparing For Steam Fest
notes.content:
2 months before Steam Fest starts. Drawing, programming, and composing music. I hope I can get my demo in order by that time. I received lots of feedback and I hope to get more when Steam Fest starts. 

I want to let you all know that I will be posting a daily devlog until October. It will either be something small like some artwork or something more like a new or altered feature. If I miss a day I will post 2 devlogs the following day. So, I hope you look forward to daily posts about my progress.

Now that's out of the way, I want to redesign the first boss since I didn't like how it looked. I'm no artist, I rather consider myself "The Programmer", but I wanted to make it look more slender and look a bit more arrogant. Her same is Brigit, "The Flame of Gaia" (I know, I'm very clever). This is one of the many changes that I have listed for changes.

Keep flying high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43270491/64371e5a90f9d300d29c473941b7cede908eca4e.png[/img]

notes.title: Continued Development of MidnightKing
notes.content:
Over the past couple months, I've been redesigning the whole of the game because I realized it was kind of a mess. I've been studying music theory and overall game design so I could make the best possible experience for the players. This was my first game and I was too ambitious, I wanted to make the combat experience that I wanted but I still need to make the music and overall aesthetic to MidnightKing. I'm currently working on a trailer showcasing a little of everything I've done, I just picked up video editing so that should make things easier.

Hope you will continue supporting me, it's been a journey to get to this point.

notes.title: Where'd I go
notes.content:
Hey, I know it's been a while since I last updated the demo, I'm very sorry for that. I've been trying to get all my classes done early so I can have more time to work on my game. 

I've been designing new things in the mean time for bosses and new areas. I'm learning about sound design and music while I'm in class so I can provide the best experience for everyone. Again, I'm sorry for the delay but things take priority so I can continue working in game development.

Thank you for all the feedback you gave me, I need constructive hard criticism or I won't know how I could make my game better.
